page.layout: One printed page (right of the scan). Running head across the top: "Mosaicarum." left, "CAPUT XIV." centred, page number "821" right. Below, one block of running text, centred last lines, ending with "FINIS" in spaced capitals. Below FINIS, a woodcut ornament (not text). The narrow strip at the left edge is the neighbouring page's text and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: dæ, pars est non minima; si thronis principum & magistratuum, judicumq; subselliis, & tri-bunalibus, quæ justitiâ firmantur & stabiliun-tur, impetravero & obtinuero, scopum, quem hïc mihi præfixum ha-bui, abunde asfecu-tum sum.

page.notes: Left strip of the scan shows the edge of the neighbouring page (text from the previous page's margin); excluded as not part of this page. The woodcut ornament below FINIS is a decorative tailpiece, not text. The opening word "dæ" is a fragment continuing from the previous page. "eft" printed as "est" in the text is given as "est" under the long-s rule; the scan is clear. "judicumq;" is rendered with the abbreviation as printed.
